_comment: Person/object detector and anonymous tracker. Confidence thresholds live in safety.json (min_confidence, phone_min_confidence). budget_ms is the per-frame detect budget from models/README.md; with stride 0 brim runs the detector every frame and drops to every 2nd frame while the average is over budget. Tracks match by box overlap (track_match_iou) or a short centre jump (track_center_gate, in box sizes) within track_match_window_ms.
